evidence_scope: Japan compliance evidence plus explicit model-contingent institutional sensitivity grid
allowed_claim: Full institutional VAT abolition is modeled separately from a 0% rate with administration retained; only abolition scenarios receive the institutional compliance and allocation sensitivity component.
forbidden_claim: The institutional GDP component is an empirical bound, causal effect, or proof that a 0% VAT rate automatically removes compliance costs.

evidence_scope: Eight-scenario integration with model-contingent institutional ranges and static fiscal and household accounting references
allowed_claim: The eight-scenario matrix is operational and carries model-contingent institutional ranges plus static fiscal and household accounting references while unresolved macro and distribution outcomes remain empty with explicit statuses.
forbidden_claim: The matrix is a policy forecast, joint welfare optimum, identified Gini or FGT2 effect, complete fiscal balance, dynamic debt path, or causal VAT demand effect.
